response.justification: The candidate lacks demonstrable experience with Java/Kotlin, JVM tooling, Spring ecosystem, or enterprise IDE development — key requirements for the role. While they have broad full-stack and open-source experience, their Java exposure is minimal and unconnected to IDE internals or enterprise framework tooling, making them a poor fit despite strong general engineering skills.
strengths: Extensive full-stack and open-source development experience across multiple languages and platforms
Strong track record in developer tooling, CI/CD, and technical education (workshops, talks)
Proven ability to own complex systems and deliver end-to-end solutions in diverse environments
concerns: No evidence of professional work with Java/Kotlin IDE tooling or JVM internals
Minimal to no mention of Spring, Hibernate, Quarkus, or enterprise application server integration
Primary tech stack is TypeScript/Node.js/DLang — not aligned with JVM-focused IDE requirements
